items: Chaar carbon atoms tak ke alkanes be-rang, be-boo gases hain; pentane se heptadecane (C5 se C17) be-rang, be-boo liquids; C18 se aage ke oonche arkan mom jaise solids, jo be-rang aur be-boo bhi hain.
Alkanes non-polar ya bohat halke polar hain, pani jaise polar solvents mein na-halne wale magar hexane, benzene aur ether jaise non-polar solvents mein halne wale.

Un ke physical constants (boiling point, melting point, density) carbon atoms ki tadaad ke saath barhte hain, jabke solubility molecular mass barhne ke saath ghat-ti hai. Shakhdar zanjeer wale alkanes apne isomeric seedhi zanjeer wale alkanes se neeche ubalte hain: butane -0.5 degrees C par aur 2-methylpropane (isobutane) -11.7 degrees C par.

blocks.prompt: Shakhdar alkanes ke boiling points seedhi zanjeer wale alkanes se kam kyun hote hain (Quick Check 11.2a)?
blocks.explanation: Alkane molecules sirf kamzor intermolecular quwaton se jure hain jo is par munhasir hain ke molecules kitni satah ek doosre se mila sakte hain. Seedhi zanjeer apni poori lambai mein parosiyon ke saath let sakti hai; shakhdar isomer zyada gatha hua aur taqreeban gol hai, to kam satah chhooti hai, quwatein kamzor hain aur use ubalne ke liye kam energy chahiye.

items: C1-C4 gases, C5-C17 liquids, C18+ mom jaise solids; non-polar, pani mein na-halne wale; b.p., m.p. aur density carbon number ke saath barhte hain; shakh b.p. ghatati hai (butane -0.5 vs isobutane -11.7 degrees C).
